properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: OpenVPN installer's certificate type: the script defaults CERT_TYPE to "ecdsa" (line 530), accepts it via CLI (lines 945, 1344, 3149), offers it as the recommended menu choice (line 2874), and generates an ECDSA CA/server certificate that then pins the control-channel suites to TLS-ECDHE-ECDSA-*. Changeable here: the default and the offered choices are script constants.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: OpenVPN installer's certificate curve and TLS group configuration: prime256v1 is the default cert curve, and the tls-groups list always includes it alongside X25519/secp384r1/secp521r1, so ECDH over P-256 is offered on every deployed control channel. Changeable here: defaults and menu choices are script constants.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: OpenVPN installer's control-channel TLS key exchange: every suite the installer can write is ECDHE (elliptic-curve DH), and the tls-groups menu (line 2944) sets the ECDH curves. OpenVPN 2.x control channel has no PQ option short of a patched build. The negotiation happens in this codebase's product; the peer is any OpenVPN client.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: OpenVPN control-channel key-agreement configuration: TLS_GROUPS is emitted as tls-groups in the generated server/client config, and the group list always includes X25519 (default X25519:prime256v1:secp384r1:secp521r1, or X25519-only). Classical ECDH on the VPN control channel — the harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure. Changeable here only by what OpenVPN/oSSL supports: OpenVPN 2.6+ with a PQ-capable OpenSSL can negotiate hybrid groups once one exists in tls-groups.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Two roles: (1) secp384r1/secp521r1 in the TLS_GROUPS list emitted as tls-groups for the control channel; (2) the CERT_CURVES allowlist for easy-rsa certificate key generation, so the generated CA/server/client certs can carry secp384r1/secp521r1 ECDSA keys. Classical NIST curves in both the key agreement and the certificate path. Menu/usage-text sites present the same choices.

properties.value: AES-256 is the strong branch of the same configuration surface: AES-256-GCM/AES-256-CBC data-cipher menu options, TLS-ECDHE-*-WITH-AES-256-GCM-SHA384 control-channel menu values, TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 first in every TLS 1.3 ciphersuite list (default :534, menu "all"/"aes-256-only" branches), and the same list in test/server-entrypoint.sh for the test container.
